title: Lightweight prompt-conditioned token selector: three-arm pairwise-retrain falsifiable experiment
purpose: Isolate whether explicit paired prompt-discrimination supervision can make the fixed prompt_mean_vector scorer non-collapsing and prompt-sensitive without changing the feature cache, teacher, split, projection dimensions, FPGA query shape, or token-budget contract. The only causal variable is the paired-supervision term and its pre-registered scale.

loss_definitions.y_g: cached teacher_soft_target of the grounding prompt
loss_definitions.y_p: cached teacher_soft_target of the pointing prompt

optimization.note: about 458752 trainable parameters in a small Wt/Wv head; this is NOT 4B model training
optimization.model_selection: val L_total only; no val hyperparameter search

validation_statistics.record_to_image_aggregation: average grounding and pointing record deltas before resampling
validation_statistics.donor_rule: split-local fixed-seed image-level deterministic derangement; no self-pair; same task donor
validation_statistics.seed_aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds before bootstrap/permutation
validation_statistics.seed_sign_requirement: delta mean positive in at least 2 of 3 seeds
validation_statistics.holm_family: 3 arms x 2 controls x 2 primary metrics = 12 tests

teacher_alignment_gate_thresholds.aggregation: median over the three seeds of the best-checkpoint val correct-prompt metric

promotion_gates.A_prompt_sensitivity: same-image-other-task: both primary deltas > 0, 95% CI lower > 0, |dz| >= 0.2, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, and positive sign in >= 2/3 seeds.
promotion_gates.B_shuffled_discrimination: cross-image-same-task derangement: both primary deltas > 0, 95% CI lower > 0, |dz| >= 0.2, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, and positive sign in >= 2/3 seeds.
promotion_gates.D_teacher_alignment: median-seed val correct Spearman >= 0.0464749736 and NDCG-full >= 0.8399415696.
promotion_gates.E_generalization: >= 2/3 seeds have best_epoch > 0 and best val L_total < epoch0 val L_total.
promotion_gates.F_hardware_contract: runtime query remains 1x128; FPGA scorer remains Gx128 dot; no token-axis max/softmax/exp.

winner_rule: Only arm C_PAIR_LAMBDA_0P25_PRIMARY may be promoted, and only if it passes all gates A-F. Arms A and B are controls and are reported but can never be the winner. If C does not pass A-F the decision is NO_PROMOTION.
prohibitions: no test NPZ open, evaluation, or metric
no post-hoc change of the winner rule
no post-hoc change of the concentration evidence
